user.title: Add a 3D Home panel
user.description: 3D Home adds a page to the sidebar with a live 3D map of your home. Draw the floor plan with the Edit button once it is open.

data_description.url_path: The page opens at /<address>, for example /3d-home.

error.invalid_url_path: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only.
error.url_path_taken: Another page already uses this address.

abort.already_configured: A 3D Home panel already uses this address.
